trajectory.text:
Available tools:
- verify_emails: Simple REST API measuring email deliverability and quality. Get rid of spam traps, hard bounces, disposable or catch-all emails without breaking your budget.. This endpoint is for verifying emails.
- get_customers_list: Ticket numbers, customer portals & robo-emails aren't a great way to build trust.. Return list of mailbox customers. Customers can be filtered on any combination of first name, last name, email, and m
- generate_invoice: Quickly generate invoices through a REST API endpoint"
